remarks: This new construction by a premier local builder features classic architecture, detailed millwork, and high-end finishes throughout. The exterior includes cedar shingles, a covered front porch, and custom trim. Inside, white oak floors and custom paneling create an inviting flow. The kitchen offers handcrafted shaker cabinetry, quartz countertops, a center island, Wolf and SubZero appliances, and French doors opening to the patio and backyard. A walk-in pantry with custom shelving and quartz counters provides extra storage and prep space. The family room features a coffered ceiling and fireplace, while the designer living and dining rooms offer distinct spaces for entertaining. The primary suite includes 2 walk-in closets and a marble bath with soaking tub, oversized shower, and dual vanities. Spacious secondary bedrooms each feature custom-fitted closets and designer bathrooms. The home also offers flexible finished spaces ideal for home office, recreation, and fitness areas. Other highlights include a tiled mudroom with full bath and back stairs, a 2-car heated garage, and lush, professional landscaping. Located near town, parks, and schools, 48 Douglas showcases craftsmanship and thoughtful design in every detail.
